name: Creative Technologies and Artificial Intelligence
about: The full AI pipeline, from collecting data and training models to deploying them, taught project by project; from year 2 you specialise in AI-driven robotics or as an AI developer, with projects for real clients.

name: Cybersecurity
about: Attack-and-defence training: you learn to think like a hacker and use their tools to secure networks, cloud and industrial systems, with an internship at home or abroad. Taught entirely in English in Bruges.

name: Digital Arts and Entertainment
about: Content for games and film taught as a technical artist: mostly hands-on practice, a three-day game jam and an 18-week internship. You choose one of six majors, from game development to VFX.

name: Digital Design and Development (DEVINE)
about: Visual design, creative coding and experience design for websites, apps and installations, in a Design-UX or a Technology track, with studio projects for real briefs and an internship. Also taught in Dutch.

name: Industrial Product Design
about: The whole product design process, from concept and CAD to a production-ready prototype, about two-thirds of it in studios and workshops (wood, metal, 3D printing, laser cutting), with an optional interior-product track.

name: Applied Computer Science
about: Programming, AI, data science and cloud infrastructure, applied in one project each semester inside a simulated company where you move from junior to team lead, ending with an eight-week internship in Belgium or abroad.

name: International Business Management
about: Economics, trade, law, accounting, sales and cross-cultural communication in a shared first year, then a specialisation in Global Business, Global Supply Chain Management or International Entrepreneurship, with team projects and an internship.

name: Multimedia & Creative Technologies
about: Coding, graphic design, 3D, audio-video and UX combined with business strategy, built in KdG's FabLab through cross-disciplinary challenges, a start-up project and a three-month internship.

name: Nursing
about: A four-year, EU-recognised general nursing degree with about 2,300 hours of clinical placement across surgery, mental health, geriatrics and paediatrics, plus a Dutch course so you can talk with patients on Flemish wards.

name: Bachelor of Business Administration
about: Management, economics, entrepreneurship, quantitative methods and law taught in English in Brussels, with business games, a business project, an optional internship and optional Dutch, French, Spanish or German.

name: Bachelor of Business Engineering
about: Finance, accounting, marketing, logistics and HR built on strong maths, statistics, data analysis and modelling; a joint degree where you take courses and exams at both KU Leuven and UCLouvain Saint-Louis in central Brussels.

name: Bachelor of Engineering Technology
about: A common core of maths, physics, chemistry and computational thinking at the Group T campus, then chemical, electromechanical or electronics-and-ICT engineering technology, learnt through projects that end in designing an embedded product.

name: Bachelor of European Studies
about: Europe and the EU studied through politics, law, economics, history and philosophy in one joint Una Europa degree: you study at two or three of its partner universities and graduate with a single joint diploma.

name: Bachelor of Philosophy
about: A broad historical and systematic training in philosophy, with logic, critical thinking and close reading, at the Institute of Philosophy, home to a major philosophy library and the Husserl Archives; you add a minor in liberal arts, education or theology.

name: Bachelor of Theology and Religious Studies
about: Christianity alongside other world religions: Bible studies, systematic theology, ethics and church history, plus biblical and modern languages, in an intercultural class at a faculty that can also award church degrees.

name: Joint Bachelor in Sustainability
about: Sustainability studied across disciplines in an Una Europa joint degree of partner universities including KU Leuven: a first year together in Kraków, then study elsewhere in the alliance.

name: Bachelor of Business Management – Marketing
about: A professional business management bachelor with a marketing major, taught in English on the Brussels campus, with advanced English and a second language of your choice (French, Spanish, German or Dutch) at your own level.

name: Applied Computer Science
about: Programming, networks, security, IoT and AI in a first year at the Geel campus, then a specialisation track and a semester-long internship with a portfolio as the capstone.

name: Automotive Technology
about: Drivetrains, vehicle electronics and diagnostics, then electric, hybrid and autonomous vehicles, taught in a workshop of more than 20 cars; you specialise in motorsport, motorcycles or trucks and finish with a 12-week thesis internship.

name: Electronics-ICT
about: Electronics and ICT on the Sint-Katelijne-Waver campus, where you specialise in applied AI, embedded hardware, embedded software, infrastructure and cybersecurity, or software architecture.

name: Information Management and Multimedia: International Digital Experience Design
about: UX, interaction and motion design plus front- and back-end web development; every semester you design and build a real digital product or immersive experience and present it to a professional jury. No tech background needed.

name: International Business Management
about: International trade, marketing, finance and supply chains with a language of your choice; "3 countries in 3 years" through an international project, an exchange and a 12-week internship abroad.

name: International Communication and Media
about: Brand communication, marketing, consumer psychology and media production, with a semester abroad or a minor in year 2 and a 15-week international internship in your final year.

name: International Journalism
about: Reporting in an English-speaking newsroom from year one, with tracks such as crisis reporting and the international newsroom, an 80-day internship in Belgium or abroad and a magazine, podcast or documentary as your final work.

name: International Media and Entertainment Business
about: The business of TV, film, festivals and publishing: storytelling, media technology and transmedia production, then entrepreneurship in a start-up studio and a 16-week final internship, with study trips abroad.

name: International Tourism and Leisure
about: Tourism, management and languages taught through industry labs in immersive experiences, tour operating and corporate travel, with an exchange in year 2 and a 15-week international internship in year 3.

name: Social-Economic Sciences
about: Sociology and economics studied side by side, with maths and statistics, in a broad first year; from year 2 you major in business economics, economic analysis, social-economic analysis or sociological analysis.

name: Urban Sustainability Studies
about: How cities can tackle environment, public health, inequality and poverty, in a YUFE degree run by ten European universities: you shape your own path of courses and minors and study abroad for two or three semesters.

name: Bachelor of Science in Business Engineering
about: Finance, accounting, marketing, logistics and HR on a strong base of maths, statistics, data analysis and modelling, plus at least one other language; a joint degree taught at UCLouvain Saint-Louis and KU Leuven in central Brussels.

name: Bachelor of Science in Social Sciences
about: Political science, communication studies and sociology in one degree run with VUB, with training from statistics to interviewing and content analysis; year 1 is mostly in Brussels, later years add courses in Ghent.

name: Bachelor in Business Engineering, option Anglais
about: Maths, physics, chemistry and statistics alongside management, economics, law and marketing, preparing for a business engineering master's; about 80% taught in English, with French and a third language as courses.

name: Bachelor in Economics, option Anglais
about: Economic theory and quantitative tools first, then applied economics such as public economics, trade and econometrics; about 80% taught in English, with French and a third language as courses.

name: BA in Global Business and Entrepreneurship
about: The functions of a global company with an entrepreneurial bent, plus Python, data analysis and responsible use of AI, taught in small interactive classes with group projects, a capstone and internships in Brussels.

name: BA in International Affairs
about: Politics, economics, law and history applied to European and international relations, in small interactive classes with practitioners from EU and international institutions and internships in Brussels.

name: BA in International and European Law
about: International and EU law, from human rights and migration to trade and business law, with legal writing and moot-court advocacy; 90 to 132 credits are law. It does not by itself qualify you to practise.

name: Business Economics
about: Micro- and macroeconomics, maths and statistics alongside marketing, finance and management, taught in English in Brussels; in the final year you choose International Business or Business and Technology.

name: Linguistics and Literary Studies
about: Linguistics and literature across up to seven languages: you pick two major languages and up to two more, with courses in language skills, writing and analysis, in multilingual Brussels.

name: Social Sciences (with Ghent University)
about: Sociology, political science and communication studies taught together around real problems, with research methods from statistics to interviews and participant observation; you study in Brussels and Ghent and hold student cards for both.

name: International Undergraduate Program in Business Administration
about: Management taught exclusively in English with an analytic core: a common first year, then a management track and electives, and one or two exchange semesters in the third year (180 ECTS).

name: International Undergraduate Program in Economics & Finance
about: Economics and finance taught exclusively in English: micro, macro and corporate finance after a common first year, with the last year open to exchange, the Tri-School programme or a double degree (180 ECTS).

name: International Undergraduate Program in Management & Data Analytics
about: Management combined with data: programming, analytics, AI and machine learning alongside finance and marketing, then a data-analytics track with electives, exchange or a double degree (180 ECTS).

name: Bachelor Degree in International Studies
about: International relations, political science, history, economics, law and sociology, applied to energy, cybersecurity, migration and sustainability, with regional options from Europe to Latin America. Taught entirely in English.

name: Bachelor Degree in Management (English-taught class)
about: Iscte Business School's management degree, with one class taught entirely in English that you choose when you enrol; double-degree options with KEDGE and Pforzheim.

name: General Engineering (GENI)
about: Maths, physics, chemistry and biology with computational thinking and projects, then a pathway you shape yourself: close to one of Técnico's degrees, emerging technologies, or custom. Taught in English (180 ECTS).

name: Bachelor's in Economics
about: Economics taught in English over six semesters (180–195 ECTS), with electives from management, social sciences and law, or an internship. Only three first-year maths courses can optionally be taken in Portuguese.

name: Bachelor's in Management
about: Management taught in English over six semesters (180–195 ECTS), mixing theory with real cases, with electives from economics, social sciences and law, or an internship.

name: Bachelor's in Ocean Studies
about: An interdisciplinary ocean degree run by five NOVA schools with the universities of Algarve and Évora and the Navy's Hydrographic Institute. Taught fully in English; it opens with a field week in Faro.

name: Data Science
about: Statistics, machine learning and AI for turning large volumes of data into knowledge, taught in English at NOVA IMS on the Campolide campus; the last semester is electives (180 ECTS).

name: Information Management
about: Data-driven management: collecting, organising and analysing information with statistical and computing tools to support business decisions, taught in English (180 ECTS).

name: Information Systems
about: Designing and building the digital systems organisations run on: programming, databases, networks, AI and app development, linked to business goals. Taught in English (180 ECTS).

name: Global Public Health
about: Public and global health: policy, programmes, epidemiology, biostatistics and health economics, for work in health bodies in Portugal and international organisations. Taught in English (180 ECTS).

name: Bachelor in Economics (taught in English)
about: Economics with management, quantitative methods, law and accounting, taught in English; the third year adds electives from FEP and across the University of Porto (180 ECTS).

name: Bachelor in Business Administration (taught in English)
about: Business and economics with social sciences, law, maths and information management, plus courses on personal and social skills; taught in English (180 ECTS).

name: Ocean Sciences
about: Oceanography, marine ecosystems, climate, data and field methods in the mid-Atlantic. The 180-ECTS degree is fully taught in English, with its first year in Ponta Delgada and the next two in Horta.

name: Economics (Católica Porto School of Business and Economics)
about: Economics with economic history, geo-economics and a solid maths base, with internships and exchanges; the degree can be completed entirely in English.

name: Management (Católica Porto School of Business and Economics)
about: Management at a triple-accredited business school, with international double degrees on offer; the degree can be completed entirely in English.

name: BSc Systems and Cognitive Neuroscience
about: How neural circuits produce perception, cognition, emotion and behaviour, studied with molecular, imaging and computational methods; run with Católica's Medical School.

name: Degree in Data Science and Technology (e-learning)
about: An online distance-learning degree with the University of Saint Joseph in Macau: maths, statistics, computing, machine learning and AI for data-driven organisations. Entirely taught in English.

name: Economics
about: Economic theory with management, maths, law, sociology and history alongside, and electives in the third year. The first year is shared with Management and Finance.

name: Management
about: Core management subjects (finance, marketing, accounting, HR, operations and information systems) with economics, maths and social sciences, all taught in English.

name: Finance
about: Markets, corporate finance, accounting, tax and audit, plus fintech and sustainable finance, affiliated with the CFA Institute. The five best students can do a dual degree at Kozminski University in Poland.

name: Applied Mathematics for Economics and Management
about: Economics and management built on a strong maths core: analysis, algebra, programming, probability, operational research and econometrics, taught in English.
